name: 수프 가마 부엌
prompt: Create a high-end cinematic environment artwork for an educational fantasy escape-room game. Landscape 3:2, AAA realistic 3D game environment / film production rendering, physically plausible lighting, richly detailed materials, atmospheric perspective. Inspired by a moonlit Scottish gothic castle: cool dark teal-blue night light with warm golden lantern light. NOT an illustration, NOT vector, NOT cartoon, NOT low-poly. Beautiful and inviting for children without childish styling. No people, no creatures in the foreground, no text, no letters, no UI, no watermark. Keep the lower central foreground relatively open; interactive 3D props are placed in front later. Natural 40mm eye-level camera, horizon in the upper middle, subtle depth of field. SCENE: No people, no text, no UI, cinematic child-friendly castle kitchen, low-angle cinematic shot centered on a large copper soup cauldron releasing warm steam, a long ladle and spice jars lined along a stone counter; open central aisle foreground, warm hearth-amber glow meets cool moonlight through a kitchen window, richly detailed copper and stone texture, atmospheric steam haze, polished fantasy concept art.
